text: I can choose push or pull for a given workload and explain what an origin shield adds.
I can write correct Cache-Control headers for fingerprinted assets, shared HTML and per-user data.
I can explain ETag revalidation and why Vary: User-Agent hurts hit rate.
I can design a cache key that excludes tracking parameters but never mixes up users' or languages' content.
I can plan invalidation with versioned URLs and tag-based purges, and explain the risk of purging everything.
I can estimate CDN versus origin cost from traffic and hit rate, stating my price assumptions.
